issue.title: ACE pilot tests intermittently leave a sase-config-token-refresh thread alive past the leak-detector snapshot

task_type_fields.evidence:
Found by the sase-1vb land agent while verifying phase sase-1vb.3 (leak-gate). That phase fixed three of the four leaking globals named in epic sase-1vb's plan; this fourth did not reproduce during the phase.

The CI Telemetry test-cost global-leak blocking gate reported `sase.config.core._live_config_token_refresh_threads` (reason live-config-token-refresh-thread) as a poisoning change after these 7 nodes in run 45709304226 on master e489558571. Evidence is the artifact sase-global-leaks-e489558571a747220f7912156f1ebed7fb95e7b5:
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_spread_pilot.py::test_new_subject_spread_starts_at_top
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_header_panel_preview.py::test_bottom_pinned_body_stays_pinned_across_row_count_change
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_chrome.py::test_pilot_theme_switch_recolors_chrome_and_spread_separators
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_context_landing.py::test_new_subject_landing_survives_redelivery[page_cards]
- tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_context_landing.py::test_new_subject_landing_survives_redelivery[spread]
- tests/ace/tui/test_tribe_panel_flicker.py::test_shows_complete_tribe_document_lifecycle
- tests/ace/tui/test_tribe_panel_flicker_debounced.py::test_shows_complete_tribe_document_lifecycle

The same global also poisoned tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_vim_normal_key_containment.py nodes during the sase-1s7.5 landing (2026-11-10). Fix b0f947b91d (drain sase-config-token-refresh again at the leak-detector after-snapshot) narrowed it but did not close it.

It did not reproduce in:
- CI Telemetry 45787348404 on 32b0d45935, whose artifact lists only the other three globals
- the sase-1vb.3 613-test targeted cost-lane run
- the land agent's `tools/run_pytest cost` run of all 16 previously poisoning files on f1eaded87c (192 passed, 0 poisoning)

Roughly 1 in 3 recent Telemetry runs, never reproduced locally. Some ACE pilot app or teardown path can restart or outlive the `sase-config-token-refresh` worker after the drain. Fix it at its root; do not exempt the name from the detector.
task_type_fields.repro_cmd: just test-cost (CI Telemetry); targeted: .venv/bin/python tools/run_pytest cost <the 7 listed files>

issue.creation_reason: The fourth global from epic sase-1vb's leak-gate phase still turns the CI Telemetry test-cost blocking gate red intermittently even after drain fix b0f947b91d. No task owns it: sase-t6 covers only the detector's own self-test.

payload.description: sase-t6 flakes on the detector's own refresh-thread snapshot test; this task is pilot tests leaving that thread alive
Process-global state leaking between tests is sase-j7's domain
Check whether it covers the leak-detector subprocess timeouts sase-1vd.4 reported
Need verify existing owner and scope for the previously confirmed config-token-thread leak signature

payload.entry: EVIDENCE (sase-1vn land agent, 2026-11-28): after epic sase-1vn's test-cost rebaseline (1b461588eb), the scheduled CI Telemetry test-cost job 46071761552 (job 140754401267) ran 63,676 passed / 140 skipped in 2:03:14, inside its 180-minute cap, and failed only on this leak gate: 4 poisoning changes on global sase.config.core._live_config_token_refresh_threads from tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_context_landing.py::test_new_subject_landing_survives_redelivery[page_cards], tests/ace/tui/widgets/decks/test_deck_spread_pilot.py::test_new_subject_spread_starts_at_top, tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_header_panel_preview.py::test_preview_row_count_matches_budget_and_short_prompt_fits, and ::test_collapsed_content_rows_are_exact. Replaying that run's uploaded cost recording (artifact sase-test-cost-1b461588eb...-attempt-1) with tools/check_test_cost_budgets --ci exits 0, so this gate is now the only thing keeping the Telemetry test-cost job and just check-full red. Earlier test-cost runs (45504040612, 45787348404, 45901602237, 45971108412) also finished in ~1h40-2h10 with failure; the workflow-level 'cancelled' conclusion comes from the separate contention-test job hitting its 90-minute cap.

Fixed by epic sase-1vy phase .1, commit 42255c3cce. Root cause: _AgentDetailHeaderEnrichmentService.shutdown(wait=False) dropped the in-flight future, so a header resolver blocked before its config read could finish after the config drain and start a fresh sase-config-token-refresh thread (reproduced deterministically by the phase). The service now keeps the future across shutdown, and drain() joins it. tests/_conftest_runtime._drain_config_producers_then_refresh drains header resolvers before joining sase-config-token-refresh, both in the autouse teardown and at the leak detector's after-snapshot. The detector exemption was not widened. Covered by test_header_resolver_late_read_does_not_poison_leak_snapshot (blocking-mode nested run, 0 poisoning) plus the ordering and timeout regressions. Land agent re-read the diff and confirmed Textual call_later is thread-safe (post_message uses call_soon_threadsafe off-thread). No CI Telemetry run has executed since the fix; a recurrence there should +1 this bead.
